integrity: The complete proof and independently implemented finite consistency checker are included. Computations verify 2407 parameter triples but are not used as an infinite proof. No external independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The proven uniform formulas require h>=3, positive d coprime to a, a>=(h-1)(h^2-h+1), and exactly three generators. The sufficient lower bound is not claimed optimal; higher-generator versions remain outside the theorem. The general literature-priority claim has residual risk from unindexed or broader specialized algorithms.
title: Exact Frobenius data for a nonmonotone three-generator family
